page.layout: One column of running text, with a centred heading-like number line above two short passages; no margin notes; signature at the foot left.

main_text.p: etiam cum baptizantur reclamant, respuunt, reluctantur: accipiunt tamen & inueniunt, pulsant & aperitur eis, & intrant in regnum Dei, vbi fit eis æternitatis salus & agnitio veritatis, longè pluribus infantibus in istam gratiam nō adoptatis ab eo qui vult omnes homines saluos fieri, & in agnitionem veritatis venire. Eod. lib. cap. 8.
Quando animositatem qua tenentur vicerint, tunc veritatem poterunt tenere qua vincuntur. lib.vlt.contra Iulian. cap. 13.

Dum contra regulam veritatis diabolicis armis pugnare nituntur, nos solicitudine respondendi faciunt cautiores: se vero decipiunt, antequam nostrorum valeant aliquem vulnerare. Cum enim cæci evacuare thesauros fidei concertant, spe fidei vacuati, faciunt plenitudinem fidei Ecclesiæ, opitulante Dei gratia gloriari: & dum in hypocrisi vigilant nocituri, nos quodammodo excitant dormientes, ut arrepto clypeo veritatis, falsitati eorum corde resistere vigilemus, Evangelica tuba nostris auribus insonante, Vigilate & orate, ne intretis in tentationem. Confidunt ergo hæretici, Catholicam fidem impugnantes, in virtute sua, id est, in audacia cordis sui, gratia desolati, & in abundantia divitiarum suarum, in operibus scilicet voluntatis suæ gloriantes.

page.notes: The page number 147 and the running head CENTVRIA IV. are printed at the head. The long s in "animositatem" and "spe" was printed as f-like forms and is rendered as plain s. The reading "vigilant" in the line "vigilat nocituri" is printed as "vigilât" and taken as vigilant; a doubtful reading. The signature at the foot is read as "K 2" with a doubt about the numeral.
